title: Money is integer cents, never float
rule: Represent and compute all monetary amounts as integer cents; never use float arithmetic for prices, totals or discounts.
why: Rounding drift caused double-charge/penny mismatches in incident #7; reverted in #8.

evidence.excerpt: Revert PR #7: Floating point rounding error created $0.01 discrepancies in invoice totals
Fix: Enforce integer cents across entire pricing pipeline

title: Payment retry calls require unique idempotency key
rule: Every call to the payment gateway must include a deterministic Idempotency-Key header or argument derived from order ID and attempt count.
why: Stripe timeout during checkout caused customers to retry and get billed twice without an idempotency key.

evidence.excerpt: Incident #10 fix: Pass idempotency key to payment gateway on checkout retry

title: Do not swallow bare Exception around payment calls; log and re-raise
rule: Catch specific payment errors (GatewayTimeoutError, CardDeclinedError). Never use bare `except Exception:` without re-raising or transitioning order state.
why: A bare except masked transaction failures, causing the order to mark fulfilled while card was never charged.

evidence.excerpt: Please catch GatewayError specifically, bare except leaves DB in indeterminate state

title: Database queries inside loops (N+1) are forbidden; use joinload or batching
rule: Eagerly load related models with `joinedload` or `selectinload`. Do not query individual foreign records in loop iterations.
why: Catalog page triggered 250 individual SQL queries for product reviews, resulting in a 4.2s latency spike.

evidence.excerpt: Revert: N+1 query loop in product catalog endpoint caused high DB CPU load

title: All new API endpoints require authentication dependency
rule: FastAPI path operations must explicitly declare `Depends(get_current_user)` or `Depends(require_auth)` unless decorated with `@public_endpoint`.
why: An unauthenticated internal webhook route accidentally exposed customer address data.

evidence.excerpt: Every new route must inject get_current_user unless explicitly flagged public

title: Never log full credit card details, CVV, or unredacted PII payloads
rule: Scrub payload dictionaries before passing to logger. Retain only last 4 card digits and masked email addresses.
why: PCI DSS compliance audit flag: raw webhook payloads printed customer CVV and card numbers to Datadog.

evidence.excerpt: Security hotfix: Mask card_number and cvv fields before calling logger.info

title: Database migrations must be reversible with downgrade steps
rule: Alembic migrations must implement both `upgrade()` and `downgrade()`. Avoid destructive column drops without deprecation phase.
why: Failed deployment rollback stalled production because migration had `pass` in `downgrade()`.

evidence.excerpt: Downgrade is empty! If this deploy fails in prod we cannot roll back cleanly.

title: Raw SQL string formatting or concatenation is strictly prohibited
rule: Always use SQLAlchemy text(:param) or ORM queries. Never use f-strings or % formatting to assemble SQL statements.
why: Identified SQL injection vulnerability in search filter query during internal red team review.

evidence.excerpt: Vulnerability fix: Convert search f-string query to bound parameter statement

title: Always configure explicit timeouts on external HTTP client calls
rule: Pass `timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5.0, read=15.0)` to all httpx and requests client invocations.
why: Unresponsive external tax rate provider hung worker threads, exhausting connection pools.

evidence.excerpt: Httpx client has no timeout specified, worker will hang indefinitely if remote host freezes

title: Multi-tenant cache keys must prefix the tenant or organization ID
rule: Format Redis and in-memory cache keys as `tenant:{org_id}:{resource}:{id}`. Never cache global IDs across tenants.
why: Cross-tenant cache bleed exposed customer order history to another authenticated account.

evidence.excerpt: Incident: Prefix cache keys with org_id to eliminate cross-tenant data contamination

title: Password hashing must use Argon2id or bcrypt with appropriate cost factor
rule: Use passlib or argon2-cffi. Never use raw hashlib algorithms (SHA256, MD5) for password verification.
why: Static security scan flagged legacy SHA256 helper used in test utility migrating into production route.

evidence.excerpt: SHA256 is not acceptable for user passwords; use Argon2id

title: Background queue jobs must be idempotent to tolerate worker restart
rule: Tasks executed via jobs table or message queue must verify processing state or record completion key before side-effects.
why: Worker pod restart during email delivery sent customer 5 order confirmation emails.

evidence.excerpt: Ensure job checks if email_sent flag is already true before triggering provider

title: Sensitive API tokens must not be exposed in client-facing error payloads
rule: Sanitize internal exception strings and stack traces before serializing HTTP 500 error responses.
why: Database connection string containing credentials leaked in 500 error body on DB timeout.

evidence.excerpt: Hotfix: Catch SQLAlchemyError and return generic error message instead of raw exception string

title: Date and timestamp arithmetic must use timezone-aware UTC datetime objects
rule: Construct timestamps with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Never use naive `datetime.utcnow()` or compare naive and aware datetimes.
why: DST changeover caused coupon expiry check to prematurely reject valid discounts for 1 hour.

evidence.excerpt: Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead of datetime.utcnow() which is deprecated in Python 3.12

title: Validate file uploads against magic byte signatures, not file extensions
rule: Inspect file header bytes using python-magic or pure byte matching. Never rely solely on client-supplied Content-Type or filename extension.
why: Malicious SVG containing embedded script bypassed avatar image upload extension check.

evidence.excerpt: Check actual PNG/JPEG magic bytes, file extensions can be spoofed by attackers
